Black Friday / Cyber Monday 2026 · checked 2026-10-31

The Black Friday VPS price isn’t what you pay at renewal.

Answer: The Black Friday price is not what you pay at renewal. As of 2026-10-31, Hostinger's VPS sale (runs Oct 19 – Dec 14, 2026) lists KVM 2 (2 vCPU / 8 GB) at $8.79/mo, but only on a 24-month prepay ($210.96 today). It renews at $14.99/mo (+71%) for the same 24-month term, billed up front again ($359.76), so keeping it past 2 years costs $570.72 in cash by month 25. The biggest renewal jump is KVM 4: $12.99 → $28.99 (+123%). If you can’t prepay 24 months: OVHcloud VPS-1 (2 vCPU / 4 GB, $5.35/mo, no commitment) costs less than Hostinger KVM 1 at 1, 2 and 3 years ($192.60 vs $443.52 over 3 years).

  • Deals verified on vendor pages: 4 (Hostinger KVM 1, 2, 4, 8)
  • Sale window: Oct 19 – Dec 14, 2026 (Hostinger’s Black Friday page, read 2026-10-31)
  • Prepay required: 24 months, paid up front ($155.76–$623.76)
  • Renewal jump: +71% to +123%, billed for the same 24-month term
  • Checked with no Black Friday VPS price shown: 7 providers
  • Last verified: 2026-10-31

Deal price vs what you actually pay

USD, list prices before tax. “1 year” is cash out of pocket: the deal requires a 24-month prepay, so leaving after 12 months still costs the full prepay (after the 30-day money-back window). “3 years (cash)” = the prepay + one renewal, because Hostinger’s page says it “Renews at $X/mo for the same term”: at month 25 you pay another 24 months up front, which covers you to month 48. Hostinger’s page shows no 12-month renewal price, so we don’t assume one. Moving off at month 24 instead? Your cost is the “2 years” column.

How to judge any Black Friday VPS deal

  • Find the renewal price and the term it renews for. If it renews for the same 24-month term, that whole term is billed up front at month 25.
  • Find the prepay. “$8.79/mo” billed as $210.96 today is a 24-month commitment.
  • Compare 3-year cash, not the headline monthly rate, against a monthly-billed plan you could leave any time.
  • Count the extras: backups (included at Hostinger, +20% at Vultr), IPv4, bandwidth overage.

Questions

What is the best Black Friday VPS deal in 2026?

We only list deals we read on the vendor's own page. As of 2026-10-31 that is Hostinger's VPS sale (Oct 19 – Dec 14, 2026): KVM 1 $6.49/mo (renews $11.99), KVM 2 $8.79/mo (renews $14.99), KVM 4 $12.99/mo (renews $28.99), KVM 8 $25.99/mo (renews $49.99), each on a 24-month prepay. It is not always the cheapest option: If you can’t prepay 24 months: OVHcloud VPS-1 (2 vCPU / 4 GB, $5.35/mo, no commitment) costs less than Hostinger KVM 1 at 1, 2 and 3 years ($192.60 vs $443.52 over 3 years). DigitalOcean, Vultr, Hetzner, OVHcloud, DreamHost, IONOS, Contabo showed no Black Friday VPS price on the pages we read that day.

How much does a Hostinger Black Friday VPS cost after renewal?

KVM 1: $6.49/mo now, renews at $11.99/mo (+85%); KVM 2: $8.79/mo now, renews at $14.99/mo (+71%); KVM 4: $12.99/mo now, renews at $28.99/mo (+123%); KVM 8: $25.99/mo now, renews at $49.99/mo (+92%). Hostinger's page says the renewal is "for the same term", so renewing a 24-month plan is billed up front again (KVM 2: $359.76). Cash by month 25: KVM 1 $443.52, KVM 2 $570.72, KVM 4 $1,007.52, KVM 8 $1,823.52.

When does the Hostinger Black Friday sale end?

Hostinger's Black Friday page says: "The Hostinger Black Friday sale runs from October 19 to December 14, 2026." (read 2026-10-31). Prices can change during the sale; re-check before you pay.

Do I have to prepay to get the Black Friday VPS price?

Yes for Hostinger: the page says "All plans are paid upfront" and each deal shows the 24-month total (KVM 1 $155.76). Hostinger offers a 30-day money-back guarantee. OVHcloud, Vultr and DigitalOcean plans in our table bill monthly with no prepay.
